arxiv-2109-09501.creator: Asutosh Kumar P. G. Department of Physics, Gaya College, Magadh University, Rampur, Gaya 823001, India Harish-Chandra Research Institute, HBNI, Chhatnag Road, Jhunsi, Prayagraj 211 019, India Vaidic and Modern Physics Research Centre, Bhagal Bhim, Bhinmal, Jalore 343029, India (asutoshk.phys@gmail.c
arxiv-2109-09501.description: Abstract Abstract. The Fibonacci sequence is a series of positive integers in which, starting from 0 and 1 , every number is the sum of two previous numbers, and the limiting ratio of any two consecutive numbers of this sequence is called the golden ratio .

arxiv-2211-05596.title: Prompt Learning for Domain Adaptation in Task-Oriented Dialogue Thanks: Work done as part of an internship with NVIDIA
arxiv-2211-05596.creator: Makesh Narsimhan Sreedhar, Christopher Parisien
arxiv-2211-05596.description: Abstract Conversation designers continue to face significant obstacles when creating production-quality task-oriented dialogue systems. The complexity and cost involved in schema development and data collection is often a major barrier for such designers, limiting their ability to create natural, user-friendly experiences.

arxiv-2211-09435.title: Observation of gauge boson joint-polarisation states in W ± ​ Z W^{\pm}Z production from p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2211-09435.description: Abstract Measurements of joint-polarisation states of W W and Z Z gauge bosons in W ± ​ Z W^{\pm}Z production are presented. The data set used corresponds to an integrated luminosity of 139 139 fb -1 of proton–proton collisions at a centre-of-mass energy of 13 13 TeV recorded by the ATLAS detector at the CERN Large Hadron Collider.

arxiv-2308-15305.title: Calligraphs and sphere realizations
arxiv-2308-15305.creator: Matteo Gallet ⋄, Georg Grasegger ∘, Niels Lubbes ∗, Josef Schicho
arxiv-2308-15305.description: Abstract We introduce a recursive procedure for computing the number of realizations of a minimally rigid graph on the sphere up to rotations. We accomplish this by combining two ingredients. The first is a framework that allows us to think of such realizations as of elements of a moduli space of stable rational curves with marked points.

arxiv-2406-17342.title: Masked Generative Extractor for Synergistic Representation and 3D Generation of Point Clouds
arxiv-2406-17342.creator: Hongliang Zeng, Ping Zhang, Fang Li, Jiahua Wang, Tingyu Ye, Pengteng Guo
arxiv-2406-17342.description: Abstract Representation and generative learning, as reconstruction-based methods, have demonstrated their potential for mutual reinforcement across various domains. In the field of point cloud processing, although existing studies have adopted training strategies from generative models to enhance representational capabilities, these methods are limited by their inability to genuinely generate 3D shapes.

arxiv-2508-04820.title: Automated File-Level Logging Generation for Machine Learning Applications using LLMs: A Case Study using GPT-4o Mini
arxiv-2508-04820.creator: Mayra Sofia Ruiz Rodriguez, SayedHassan Khatoonabadi, Emad Shihab
arxiv-2508-04820.description: Abstract Logging is essential in software development, helping developers monitor system behavior and aiding in debugging applications. Given the ability of large language models (LLMs) to generate natural language and code, researchers are exploring their potential to generate log statements.

arxiv-2510-00706.title: AttentionDep : Domain-Aware Attention for Explainable Depression Severity Assessment
arxiv-2510-00706.creator: Yusif Ibrahimov, Tarique Anwar, Tommy Yuan, Turan Mutallimov, Elgun Hasanov
arxiv-2510-00706.description: Abstract In today’s interconnected society, social media platforms provide a window into individuals’ thoughts, emotions, and mental states. This paper explores the use of platforms like Facebook, 𝕏 \mathbb{X} (formerly Twitter), and Reddit for depression severity detection. We propose AttentionDep , a domain-aware attention model that drives explainable depression severity estimation by fusing contextual and domain knowledge.

arxiv-2512-09431.title: A Hierarchical, Model-Based System for High-Performance Humanoid Soccer
arxiv-2512-09431.creator: Quanyou Wang, Mingzhang Zhu, Ruochen Hou, Kay Gillespie, Alvin Zhu, Shiqi Wang, Yicheng Wang, Gaberiel I. Fernandez, Yeting Liu, Colin Togashi, Hyunwoo Nam, Aditya Navghare, Alex Xu, Taoyuanmin Zhu, Min Sung Ahn, Arturo Flores Alvarez, Justin Quan, Ethan Hong, Dennis W. Hong
arxiv-2512-09431.description: Abstract The development of athletic humanoid robots has gained significant attention as advances in actuation, sensing, and control enable increasingly dynamic, real-world capabilities. RoboCup, an international competition of fully autonomous humanoid robots, provides a uniquely challenging benchmark for such systems, culminating in the long-term goal of competing against human soccer players by 2050.

arxiv-2601-21445.description: Abstract There are two objectives to this work: to classify all tame integer tilings and to classify all tame integer hypertilings. Motivation for the first objective comes from Conway and Coxeter’s modelling of positive integer friezes using triangulated polygons, which has received significant attention since the discovery of cluster algebras by Fomin and Zelevinsky in 2002.

pmc-11334246.title: Treatment patterns and factors associated with discontinuation of monoclonal antibodies
pmc-11334246.creator: Muzoon Matar Saleh Alkaabi, Syed Arman Rabbani, Padma GM Rao, Mai Ismail Mohamedelhassan
pmc-11334246.description: Background:Biological agents have revolutionized care in specialties such as oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, and genetic disorders, offering targeted actions on specific molecules or select immune cells. Monoclonal antibodies, known for their high specificity and precision, represent one of the most significant and rapidly expanding categories of these agents.

pmc-11595847.title: Effect of Waste Concrete Powder Content and Microwave Heating Parameters on the Properties of Porous Alkali-Activated Materials from Coal Gangue
pmc-11595847.creator: Vasilii Mischinenko, Andrey Vasilchenko, Georgy Lazorenko
pmc-11595847.description: The objective of this research is to fabricate waste-based alkali-activated foams with better properties in a quick time by using energy-efficient techniques such as microwave irradiation. The present study reports the effect of microwave heating parameters, including heating time and output power, on the properties of porous alkali-activated materials (AAMs) that use coal gangue (CG) as a precursor.

pmc-11696784.title: Key drivers and priorities of consumer decisions for refurbished electronics: A mix-method approach
pmc-11696784.creator: Fatemeh Barkhi, Sadra Ahmadi, Sajad Shokouhyar, Raffaele Filieri, Masoud Ramezaninia
pmc-11696784.description: Product refurbishment enhances waste minimization and environmental sustainability. However, the sale of these products relies on consumer attitudes, influenced by various factors. This study adopts a novel mixed-methods approach, utilizing structural and network analysis based on over 60,000 comments and tweets from X.

pmc-12472219.title: Optimization of (Dithioperoxo)thiolate-Based Antifungal Agents for Triazole-Resistant Aspergillus Fumigatus
pmc-12472219.creator: Surya Karuturi, Kaitlyn L Jobe, Melinda E Varney, Michael D Hambuchen, A R M Ruhul Amin, Timothy E Long, Monika I Konaklieva, Balbina J Plotkin
pmc-12472219.description: This investigation on novel antifungal agents featuring a thiol-reactive (dithioperoxo)thiolate chemical nucleus [-NC(S)S-SR] established that the optimal levels of fungal growth inhibition were achieved with thiomethyl-bound derivatives (R = Me). The most efficacious analogs had MIC50/MIC90 values of 2/2 µg/mL and an MIC range of 1 to 2 µg/mL for a ten-member panel of voriconazole-resistant A. fumigatus mutants.

pmc-12528466.title: Association between eHealth literacy and anxiety and depression in Chinese patients scheduled for combined orthodontic and orthognathic treatment
pmc-12528466.creator: Hongyuan Dai, Xin Yang, Jun Zhao, Yiyi Huang, Chao Peng, Yuxing Tian, Ying Wu, Zengxiang Wang
pmc-12528466.description: To investigate the level of eHealth literacy among patients scheduled for combined orthodontic and orthognathic treatment, and to explore its association with anxiety and depression, providing a basis for clinical interventions. A cross-sectional study was conducted with a final sample of 111 patients.

pmc-12551475.title: Predicting risk factors of non-utilisation of postnatal care in three neighbouring East African countries: application of the decision tree
pmc-12551475.creator: Chenai Mlandu, Zvifadzo Matsena-Zingoni, Eustasius Musenge
pmc-12551475.description: IntroductionPostnatal care (PNC) is recommended for the optimal health of mothers and newborns; however, PNC uptake remains poor in sub-Saharan Africa. Traditional statistical approaches have been used to predict healthcare service utilisation more often but are limited in examining complex relationships compared with decision tree (DT) models.

pmc-12753729.title: National assessment of transit electrification in Canada: infrastructure costs, energy demand, and greenhouse gas reduction potential
pmc-12753729.creator: Hatem Abdelaty, Moataz Mohamed
pmc-12753729.description: Battery electric buses (BEBs) offer a scalable solution for decarbonizing public transit; however, comprehensive national-level assessments remain limited. This study presents the first bottom-up evaluation of BEB adoption across Canada, using open-source data from 102 transit providers. We quantify fleet requirements, infrastructure needs, electricity demand, and the cost-effectiveness of greenhouse gas (GHG) reductions under a fully electrified bus transit system.

pmc-13062141.title: Highly Conductive and Stable Naphthalenediimide-Based Organic Salt Cathode for Robust Lithium-Ion Batteries
pmc-13062141.creator: Xiangyu Su, Zixuan Shan, Xuan Peng, Jianyi Chu, Zhihao Jia, Yanan Kou, Min Jiang, Yuan Chen
pmc-13062141.description: Highlights A naphthalenediimide-based lithium salt (NDI-OLi) featuring a stable π-conjugated structure and high aromaticity is proposed as a cathode, which facilitates relatively high electronic conductivity and rapid electron transfer.Experimental and theoretical investigations reveal that the stable delocalized electronic geometry and fast reaction kinetics enable sufficient coupling between carbonyl sites and lithium ions, ensuring excellent energy storage performance.

pmc-13299400.title: Seasonal Population Dynamics of Mosquitoes in Taipei, Taiwan
pmc-13299400.creator: Da-Gang Huang, Hsin-Chieh Tang, Chi-Wei Tsai
pmc-13299400.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryBeyond being a persistent nuisance, mosquitoes serve as primary vectors for pathogens that pose a global threat to human health. In Taipei, Taiwan, however, comprehensive data regarding mosquito population dynamics has remained outdated for decades. To address this gap, we conducted a two-year survey from June 2023 to May 2025, employing biweekly trapping of mosquitoes using ultraviolet light and dry ice at three locations. Our surveillance yielded 1926 female mosquito specimens across 31 species.

pmc-13359829.title: Repurposing cepharanthine as a radiosensitizer in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma through dual metabolic intervention and direct targeting of p70s6K
pmc-13359829.creator: Zhihua Hao, Xin Su, Jiantao Li, Jing Jin, Zheng Li, Zhiqiang Yan, Wenpeng Jiao, Wenjing Jiao, Yingying Wang, Chenguang Ji, Xuan Wang, Yutong He
pmc-13359829.description: BackgroundMetabolic reprogramming underpins the acquisition of radioresistance in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC); however, the specific bioenergetic vulnerabilities and direct pharmacological targets remain to be fully elucidated. This study defines a distinct metabolic phenotype conferring radioresistance and evaluates the natural alkaloid Cepharanthine (CEP) as a mechanism-driven radiosensitizer.

pmc-13417978.title: GPR180 deficiency impairs mitochondrial function and insulin secretion in pancreatic β-cells
pmc-13417978.creator: Matus Antal, Tina Dahlby, Peter Makovicky, Anastasiia Novak, Carla Horvath, Daniela Stanikova, Simona Gazova, Radana Brumarova, Eliska Ivanovova, Martina Horejsova, David Friedecky, Olga Krizanova, Marta Novotova, Daniela Gasperikova, Miroslav Balaz, Lucia Balazova
pmc-13417978.description: ObjectivesG protein-coupled receptor 180 (GPR180) has been implicated in systemic energy metabolism, primarily in adipose tissue and the liver. Given impaired whole-body glucose tolerance following GPR180 dysfunction, we aimed to determine whether GPR180 regulates pancreatic β-cell function. We investigated whether GPR180 contributes to β-cell insulin secretion by modulating metabolic processes that couple glucose sensing to mitochondrial energy production.

pmc-13670557.creator: Hossein Farhadnejad, Hamid Ahmadirad, Zahra Dianati, Mitra Kazemi Jahromi, Niloufar Saber, Farshad Teymoori, Parvin Mirmiran, Fereidoun Azizi
pmc-13670557.description: Background/AimMetabolic syndrome (MetS) increases the risk of type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular diseases, with oxidative stress playing an important role in its development. This study aimed to examine the association between the Composite Dietary Antioxidant Index (CDAI), a measure of total dietary antioxidant intake, and the risk of MetS in Iranian adults.
